test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

We stayed / in Jim's flat / during he was / on holiday.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'during he was'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'when he was'** should be used instead of 'during he was'
